name: Experimental structural evidence through homologs
description: Investigate experimentally constrained structural features of homologs and their relevance to the supplied target through sequence or structural correspondence.
investigation_instructions:
Determine what functions or molecular features the supplied gene or protein may have from experimentally observed structural features of relevant homologs. Start from the supplied sequence, selected file record or region, or snippets; no candidate annotation, searchable public name or experimental target structure is required. Preserve partial-material limits and identify the actual experimentally studied subject separately from the supplied target.

Examine experimentally constrained ligand or metal assignments, contacts, conformations, catalytic or recognition sites, and assemblies that can distinguish possible functions. Retain the construct, preparation, chains, experimental method and the conditions that produced the observed state. Keep measured data, the refined model interpreting those data, and wholly predicted or docked structures distinct. A docked ligand is not an observed ligand; unidentified density does not acquire a chemical identity from a plausible fit alone.

Preserve reported resolution, occupancy, contact distances and other relevant native quantities with units, uncertainty and method-appropriate validation. Identify the atoms, residues and chains underlying a contact or calculated distance. A coordinate-derived distance shares the structure’s experimental dependency; it is not a second experiment. Missing or unresolved density does not by itself establish physical absence.

Transfer the particular structural observation through actual sequence correspondence OR structural correspondence that maps the relevant residues, site, domain or assembly surface to the target. Examine the corresponding geometry, molecular features and informative differences. A whole-fold resemblance alone does not establish that a specific contact or ligand-recognition feature is shared. The source observation and the target inference remain separate.

Use observed alternative states, chemical identification or selective functional comparisons when they distinguish competing interpretations. Retain ligand ambiguity and non-native preparation or assembly limits. Occupancy and contact geometry do not by themselves establish affinity, catalysis, transport, partner necessity or physiological responsibility. Keep the structural feature supported by experiment distinct from structural similarity and from any separately measured molecular activity.

evidence.observation: Activity-guided D-threonate complex and ADP complex localized distinct substrate/nucleotide sites; ADP structure showed domain closure.

evidence.limit: Primary relevant results plus 1WUB inspected; complete methods not read.
evidence.observation: Density in the hydrophobic barrel was modeled as octaprenyl pyrophosphate; mass spectrometry supported a C40 isoprenoid.

evidence.limit: Three primary E. coli relevant Results/Methods inspected, with earlier other-species nuclease comparators explicitly limited; new descriptive deposited-coordinate comparison. No biological experiments or new annotation run. | Source observation limit: Contact presence alone does not establish functional necessity: R77 is an explicit tolerated contact-site example. Not every Cas2 contact mutant was directly assayed for binding affinity in isolation.
evidence.observation: A four-Cas1/two-Cas2 complex positions the central donor duplex over Cas2 and terminal donor 3-prime ends in two Cas1 sites. Cas2 R16/R78 are part of a phosphate-backbone clamp; R16E and R78E strongly reduce in vivo acquisition, whereas R77E is tolerated. Cas1 clamp/channel and end-splaying mutants supply additional functional comparisons.

evidence.limit: Full primary Results on architecture, length threshold, pore-loop mutants and crosslinking read. No structural re-refinement. | Group source-use limits: Cryo-EM, crosslinking and complementation are different connected modalities; they are not three direct transport assays. Lipid identity, direction and net flux remain unresolved.
evidence.observation: Structure shows a periplasm-length hydrophobic tunnel. Lipid crosslinking places phosphate-bearing material inside it. Length and pore-loop mutants lose ability to complement a sensitized pqiAB/letAB detergent phenotype.
